conflict.note: The retained NSE Issue Information describes an initial offer up to INR 19,600.05 million, including anchor allocation. The later Final Prospectus states INR 15,934.49 million subject to finalization of the Basis of Allotment and excludes multiple bids and bids not banked. These are different-stage/scope disclosures. Preserve both observations; prefer the prospectus candidate without calling it verified or claiming a finalized raised amount. Reconcile against an official final basis-of-allotment disclosure before resolving.

review_notes: All three original PDFs and their landing responses independently match collection receipt hashes and lengths. Relevant pages rendered and visually reviewed; physical PDF pages are 1-based.
Droneacharya is not Drone Destination Limited / NSE DRONE. No pre-existing Droneacharya identity in any recovery year at the pinned baseline.

SEBI order is used only for the explicit historical listing statement on page 2. Its broad IPO period includes anchor day; prospectus public and anchor schedules are retained separately. No current regulatory-status or investment conclusion is added.

The Five-Star landing page is labelled 16 November 2022 but currently links a May-2023-path PDF whose cover is dated 15 November 2022. Path date is not document or publication date. PDF publication dates remain null; landing labels are separately retained.
Source units and qualifications are preserved; only explicit lakh/million-to-INR normalization is performed. No minimum application amount is inferred.
